blocks.title: Refrigerator
blocks.text: Refrigerator woh device hai jo kisi jism ka temperature us ke mahol se neeche qaim rakhta hai. Yeh cyclic amal mein chalta hai magar heat engine ke ulat (Fig. 6.10): refrigerator thande reservoir se heat jazb karta hai aur garam reservoir ko deta hai. Yeh dikhata hai ke refrigerator mein kaam system par hota hai, jabke heat engine mein kaam system karta hai.

Refrigerator thermodynamics ke doosre qanoon ke Clausius ke bayan ki bunyad par kaam karta hai, ulta chalte heat engine ke taur par. Compressor kam temperature ke reservoir (LTR) se heat Q_C kheenchta hai aur bahri kaam ki madad se zyada temperature ke reservoir (HTR) mein phenkta hai. HTR ko di heat Q_H, Q_C + W = Q_H, ya W = Q_H - Q_C se milti hai. Refrigerator ka bunyadi maqsad jitna kam kaam W ho sake us ke kharch par LTR se zyada se zyada heat Q_C nikalna hai.

blocks.title: Coefficient of performance
blocks.text: LTR se hatai heat (Q_C) ki kiye kaam (W) se nisbat refrigerator ka coefficient of performance kehlati hai. Behtar refrigerator kam mechanical kaam ya bijli ki energy ke kharch par refrigerator ke andar se zyada heat hatata hai: E = Q_C / W = Q_C / (Q_H - Q_C). Temperature ke zariye, jahan Q T ke tanasub mein hai, E = T1 / (T2 - T1), T1 thande reservoir ka aur T2 garam reservoir ka temperature.

blocks.title: Example 6.4
blocks.text: Refrigerator ka coefficient of performance 8 hai. Agar freezer ka temperature -23 degrees C ho to woh kis temperature par heat nikalta hai? Hal: E = 8; thande reservoir (freezer) ka temperature T1 = -23 degrees C = -23 + 273 = 250 K; garam reservoir (kamra) ka temperature T2 = ?. Coefficient of performance E = T1/(T2 - T1); rakhne par 8 = 250/(T2 - 250), ya 8 (T2 - 250) = 250, ya T2 - 250 = 250/8, ya T2 = 31.25 + 250 = 281.25 K = 8.25 degrees C.

blocks.alt: Block diagram: refrigerator neeche thande khane (T2) aur oopar garam mahol (T1) ke darmiyan hai. Yeh thandi taraf se hararat Q2 leta hai, electric motor se kaam W leta hai, aur mahol ko hararat Q1 = Q2 + W deta hai. Note kehta hai hararat khud thandi se garam taraf nahi behti.
blocks.caption: Refrigerator kaam (work) se thande khane ki hararat garam mahol mein le jata hai (Figure 6.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Refrigerator har cycle apne andar se 1200 J nikalta aur mahol ko 1800 J deta hai; kaam input aur coefficient of performance nikalein (numerical 6.5). Kya refrigerator thande se garam ki taraf heat le ja kar doosre qanoon ki khilaf-warzi karta hai (short question 6.7)?
blocks.explanation: W = Q_H - Q_C = 1800 - 1200 = 600 J; E = Q_C/W = 1200/600 = 2. Nahi: Clausius ka bayan heat ke khud ba khud thande se garam ki taraf bahne ko mana karta hai; refrigerator use sirf bahri kaam se le jata hai, aur system jama mahol ki kul entropy phir bhi barhti hai.

items: Refrigerator: ulta heat engine (Clausius); thande hisse se Q_C liya, system par W kiya, Q_H = Q_C + W mahol ko diya. Coefficient of performance E = Q_C/W = Q_C/(Q_H - Q_C) = T1/(T2 - T1). Example 6.4: T2 = 281.25 K = 8.25 degrees C.
